scripts.build:windows: PATH="$(brew --prefix llvm)/bin:$PATH" tauri build --runner cargo-xwin --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc --bundles nsis
scripts.test:backend: cd backend && cargo test && cargo test --manifest-path vendor/tiberius/Cargo.toml --no-default-features --features tds73 --lib && cargo test --manifest-path vendor/tokio-postgres/Cargo.toml --lib
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter frontend format:check && pnpm --filter frontend lint && pnpm --filter frontend typecheck && cd backend && cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo fmt --check
scripts.format: pnpm --filter frontend format && cd backend && cargo fmt
